rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone is not willing to do something.

example.english: I am unwilling to move so far away.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 jyun6 ji3 bun1 heoi3 gam3 jyun5 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when the person is refusing or will not comply with a request, often followed by an action.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dim2 hyun3 dou1 m4 hang2 dou6 hip3

rows.note: Use this when someone does something reluctantly or against their wishes, rather than simply refusing.

example.english: I am unwilling to do this, but I have no choice.
example.traditional: 我唔情願咁做，但係冇辦法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 cing4 jyun6 gam3 zou6 daan6 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3
